title: Simple Hedge Mod
description: A mod that adds a custom vanilla styled hedge block with special traits and flowering variants!
body:
# Simple Hedges Mod

This mod adds a new block to the game, the Hedge block! The Hedge is a decoration block that can be used for decorating your builds! 

![In-game Screenshot of Hedge Block](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/102da1311159f4ed3cd74e3770fb0f1fdd94c566.png)
## Crafting

Crafting a hedge is really easy! Just surround a stick with any type of leaf block to make a hedge.

![Gif of Hedge Crafting](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/18fac78856b2afaeadb8f59ed8882867a7f57331.gif)
## Functionality

- The hedge has lots of cool functionality for building and decoraction. First the block is visually 1.5 blocks tall but its physically only one block tall which allows for hedges to combine seemlessly into tall hedge walls that could be used for all sorts of builds. They could also be placed under blocks to give a mossy look to builds like for a fallen log taken over by moss.

![In-game Screenshot of a House and Hedges](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a47c07025e397f7786dd435ed5d79737aad5e415.png)
- One of the coolest features of the hedge are that you can place flowers on them like with pots! Simply right clicking a hedge with a flower turns the hedge into a flowering hedge with the flower of choice! To remove flowers you can break the block or use shears to snip it off!

![In-game Screenshot of Flowering Hedges](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/08705d667e553a4dfd2c2667483f6e5cad0a3517.png)
- Aswell as regular flowers, bees can now get pollen from flowering hedges too!

![In-game Screenshot of Bees using a Flowering Hedge](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2073338d41470aaffd230197813ac51cfabdc744.png)
- Crouching while walking into a hedge allows you to walk through hedges! Create secret entrances to mystical lands or sneaky traps for your enemies to unwittingly fall for! Be careful not to walk through hedges with wither roses on them!

![Gif of player going through a Hedge](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/Legb7DW8/images/7779b229bec115cbcb919fd61c13069a41fe5ff1.gif)
